answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood attestations. Mechanism: each new identity stakes a violet bond on a geographic knoll registry keyed to meadow-scoped peer vouchers — only peers with ≥3 prior final answers in that meadow may vouch, and each voucher burns 0.4 POA. Cost: sybils pay O(n) burns per clone. Verification: ledger rejects attests lacking two live vouchers with matching knoll ids. Failure: if a voucher peer is later invalidated, dependent bonds slash 50% and the clone loses attest weight for 2 epochs.
